meta.name: SDE1 interview roadmap
meta.basedOn: Sequence adapted from Tech Interview Handbook (yangshun) and takeUforward's interview roadmap: resume/profiles first, CS core + DSA in parallel, behavioral bank before the Jan 8 job-search start, applications + OA tracking through the Jan–Feb 2027 search window.

sources.title: Tech Interview Handbook
sources.note: The master flow this roadmap follows

sources.title: takeUforward — Striver's SDE Sheet page
sources.note: Reference for the Indian-market interview loop

phases.name: CS Core
phases.desc: OS, DBMS, CN, OOP — enough depth for SDE1 theory rounds and viva-style questions. Last-minute notes + one playlist per subject.

items.title: OS: processes vs threads, scheduling, context switching
OS: synchronization — mutex/semaphore, deadlock (conditions, prevention)
OS: memory — paging, segmentation, virtual memory, thrashing
DBMS: normalization (1NF→BCNF), keys, ER model
DBMS: transactions — ACID, isolation levels, concurrency control, locks
DBMS: indexing — B+ trees, clustered vs non-clustered
CN: OSI vs TCP/IP layers, what happens when you type a URL
CN: TCP vs UDP, 3-way handshake, congestion control basics
CN: HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, TLS handshake, cookies vs sessions
OOP: 4 pillars with real code examples in your main language
OOP: interfaces vs abstract classes, composition vs inheritance
OOP: common follow-ups — static/final, overloading vs overriding, virtual functions

phases.name: DSA
phases.desc: Lives entirely in the DSA module (sidebar) — Striver A2Z + SDE sheet + NeetCode 150 deduped, with company-wise lists. Nothing duplicated here.

items.title: → Work through the DSA module daily; this item is just the pointer

phases.name: Resume & Profiles
phases.desc: One-page tech resume + every Indian job platform optimized before the Jan 8 job-search start.

items.title: One-page resume in Jake's template style: quantified bullets (X → Y by Z), tech keywords, no photo/objective

resources.title: Tech Interview Handbook — resume guide
resources.note: What to write in each bullet

items.title: LinkedIn: headline with target role + stack, About with metrics, featured projects, open-to-work (recruiters only)
Naukri: complete profile to 100%, headline keywords, ⟳ REFRESH WEEKLY (resurfaces you in recruiter search — mark revisit to auto-remind)
Instahyre: profile + preferences set to target roles/CTC
Cutshort: profile, skill quizzes if they gate visibility
Wellfound (AngelList): startup-facing profile, AI/agent projects front and center
GitHub: pin Morning TIL + best repos, each README with demo GIF and architecture diagram

phases.name: Behavioral — STAR bank
phases.desc: Write answers as Situation-Task-Action-Result. Notes field on each question = your answer. Rehearse aloud once a week from mid-Aug.

items.title: Tell me about yourself (90-second version)
Most challenging project / hardest technical problem you solved
A time you disagreed with a teammate or senior — how did you resolve it?
A mistake or failure — what did you learn and change?
A time you had to learn something quickly to deliver
A time you took ownership beyond your role
Handling a tight deadline / multiple priorities
A time you received hard feedback — how did you respond?
Why are you leaving your current company? (never negative)
Why this company / role? (research template: product, stack, one specific thing)
Questions to ask the interviewer (prepare 3 per round type)

resources.title: Tech Interview Handbook — 30 common behavioral questions

phases.name: Applications & OA tracker
phases.desc: Every application from Jan 8 goes in the table below (in the app). Statuses: applied → OA → phone → onsite → offer / rejected / ghosted.

items.title: Build target-company list (30+): product companies, funded startups, AI-first teams
Line up referrals: ex-colleagues, alumni, LinkedIn warm intros — referral > cold apply
OA practice: 2 timed mock OAs before first real one (LeetCode contests work)
